newsitem.title: USA: US crudes slide into contango, sweet barrels weak.
newsitem.headline: US crudes slide into contango, sweet barrels weak.

text.p: U.S. crude prices slipped into a deeper state of contango on Wednesday, pushing the front spot month crude below second month June values.
Foreign crude offerings in the U.S. Gulf, and expecations for a flow of even more barrels in coming weeks, pressured sweet and sour crude differentials to weaker levels.
Outright crudes faced a barrage of fund selling brought on by negative technical indicators and bearish fundamentals showing imports on the rise.
May West Texas Intermediate/Cushing talked late around 70 cents lower to $19.50-60 a barrel.
